data.title: 玛奇玛 · 超市采购
data.description: 傍晚灯火通明的生鲜超市里，玛奇玛推着购物车在生鲜区前驻足，认真挑选着新鲜的黑猪肉片与高档啤酒。她转过脸带着居家的从容与柔情看向你——「今晚打算亲自下厨做一顿丰盛的寿喜烧。电次君，想吃加了生鸡蛋的牛肉，还是浓郁的炖豆腐呢？」
data.promptProse: Pausing in the brightly lit fresh-produce and meat aisle of an evening supermarket, Makima wears her ivory silk drape blouse, cropped open jacket, and charcoal pencil skirt with effortless calm. Resting one hand lightly on the metal push-bar of her shopping cart, she tilts a packaged tray of sliced pork toward the light with her other hand while glancing calmly toward the viewer with a quiet, domestic smile. Crisp overhead store lights gleam along the refrigerated cases and tidy shelves.
data.animaCaption: Pausing beside the refrigerated supermarket aisle with one hand on her shopping cart, Makima inspects a tray of fresh meat with the other and turns toward the viewer with a calm smile. Bright overhead grocery lights reflect along the chilled display cases.
